2c0114217d.q: What does Upgrade's platform do for Energy Service Companies in the ESCO market?
2c0114217d.a: Upgrade is an intelligence platform for the built environment that pipes in multiple data sources including satellites, permitting databases, soil conductivity, weather, and solar irradiance to provide high-fidelity predictions about buildings—including HVAC systems, thermal envelope properties, EUI, and efficiency opportunities with payback periods. ESCOs use this to target buildings that need their upgrades, prepare sales conversations with day-one portfolio understanding, accelerate feasibility work by uploading utility data and photos to auto-update energy models, and generate proposal documents for meetings.
2c0114217d.e: #148 Why AI Could Expand the ESCO Market, Not Just Speed It Up

7b61a092ff.q: How will AI and technology tools change the economics of the ESCO market?
7b61a092ff.a: AI tools like Upgrade will compress pre-sale costs, shorten sales timelines, and enable more efficient meetings between buyers and sellers without extensive on-site work and feasibility studies. This allows ESCOs to handle higher volume with more qualified leads, changing the fundamental economics of an industry where a huge share of costs currently happens in pre-feasibility and sales work before contracts are signed.
7b61a092ff.e: #148 Why AI Could Expand the ESCO Market, Not Just Speed It Up

8927d0e2a5.q: Why does the ESCO industry have significant growth potential beyond market share competition?
8927d0e2a5.a: The deferred maintenance backlog in the municipal sector is growing, and energy constraints and demands are putting a premium on efficiency. Most macro forces point to tailwinds in this market, so the industry should adopt a growth mentality rather than zero-sum thinking about market share, since there will be more work than any single ESCO can handle.

fe91138dfe.q: Why does Upgrade build its own custom energy modeling instead of using frontier AI models?
fe91138dfe.a: Upgrade built its own building energy models custom-built for the ESCO purpose because this approach is more accurate than what large frontier models can do. Custom modeling allows Upgrade to provide precise predictions and is particularly important since models are less accurate for facilities with significant process loads like major industrial manufacturing.
